content_data.project_description: Comprehensive visual and UX overhaul of the first-time player journey to increase retention and engagement across European markets. Design system will support localization for 12+ languages with culturally-adaptive visual elements.
content_data.timeline: 5 months with Discovery & Research (months 1-2), Design Development (months 2-3), and Implementation Support (months 4-5)
objectives: Establish scalable design system that adapts to cultural preferences across European markets
Reduce player drop-off during first session by creating intuitive visual guidance
Increase day-7 retention through emotionally engaging onboarding narrative
deliverables: Cultural adaptation guidelines for 12 European locales
Motion design specifications and animated asset packages
Complete onboarding flow wireframes and high-fidelity mockups
Comprehensive design system documentation with component library
technical_specs: Design tokens exported in JSON format for developer integration
Maximum file size constraints: 150KB per screen for mobile optimization
Color system using HSL values for dynamic theming support
Animation specifications using Lottie JSON for web implementation
creative_requirements: Culturally-neutral iconography that translates across European markets
Data visualization components that gamify player progress metrics
Responsive layouts optimized for mobile, tablet, and desktop experiences
